title: Plan a sensitive audio fixture and its existing structural checks

rubric.text: Inspect encodeProfile, gainCacheKey and ProfileWireFieldsTest and include affected existing field-completeness and consumer tests even though their files are outside the edit list.

Make T1 a bounded representative fixture proof: reacquire the live mixer after recreation, crossfade while active, measure the transient region separately per channel, pass intended behavior and fail suppressed-left limiting. Restore the candidate and hold expansion on failure.

Make T2 and T3 depend on the integrated passing T1 evidence; name hypothesis, setup, pass/fail and stop or replan action. Preserve full channel/state/backend coverage and sensitivity rather than replacing acceptance with the proof.
Keep settled architecture, ownership, permissions and existing review stages; do not run the target proof, implementation, agents or provider actions during this read-only assessment.
